definitions.gloss: season; time of year; seasonal weather
definitions.explanation: The season, or the weather typical of the time of year. Now heard almost only in letter writing, above all in {時候|じこう}の{挨拶|あいさつ} (the seasonal greeting).

examples.japanese: {時候|じこう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{挨拶|あいさつ}→挨拶：02505_aisatsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{書|か}く→書く：00477_kaku⟧。
⟦{手紙|てがみ}→手紙：00675_tegami⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{時候|じこう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{挨拶|あいさつ}→挨拶：02505_aisatsu⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{始|はじ}める。
examples.english: A letter begins with a seasonal greeting.

examples.japanese: {時候柄|じこうがら}、⟦どうぞ→どうぞ：02920_douzo⟧お⟦{体|からだ}→体：00784_karada⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{大切|たいせつ}→大切：01456_taisetsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なさって→なさる：01307_nasaru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: With the season as it is, please take good care of yourself.

notes:
COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {時候|じこう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{挨拶|あいさつ}→挨拶：02505_aisatsu⟧: the seasonal greeting that opens a formal letter
- {時候柄|じこうがら}: in view of the season (in closing lines)
- {時候|じこう}⟦{見舞|みま}い→見舞い：03745_mimai⟧: a seasonal letter asking after someone, such as a summer greeting card

CULTURAL NOTE:
A formal Japanese letter opens with ⟦{拝啓|はいけい}→拝啓：12790_haikei⟧ and a line about the season, such as ⟦{新緑|しんりょく}→新緑：12724_shinryoku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{候|こう} ("in this season of fresh greenery") in May. Letter-writing guides list such phrases month by month.
